M: the steak Alex dreams about in the zoo

the fish Alex finally learns to eat on the island

Firm white fish simmered in a coconut, tomato and ginger curry with lime and chilli, served over rice with fresh coriander and toasted coconut. Soften 1 diced onion, 3 garlic cloves and 1 tbsp grated ginger in oil. Add 2 tsp mild curry powder and 1 tsp turmeric and stir 1 minute. Add 2 diced tomatoes and 400ml coconut milk and simmer 10 minutes. Slip in 800g firm white fish such as barramundi in chunks and poach gently for 6 minutes. Finish with lime juice and salt. Serve over rice with coriander and toasted coconut flakes.
W: Thick pineapple wedges grilled until charred and glazed in a brown sugar, butter and lime caramel, with coconut ice cream and toasted coconut. Cut 1 pineapple into 8 long wedges and grill on a hot pan or barbecue for 3 minutes a side until charred. Melt 60g butter with 80g brown sugar, bubble for 2 minutes, then stir in the juice of a lime and a pinch of salt. Toss the pineapple in the caramel. Serve warm with scoops of coconut ice cream and toasted coconut flakes.
K: the welcome party on the island

Mango nectar, passionfruit pulp, pineapple and lime topped with fizzing lemonade, served by the jug over crushed ice with fruit floating on top. In a large jug stir 600ml mango nectar, 300ml pineapple juice, the pulp of 4 passionfruit and the juice of 2 limes. Add diced mango and pineapple and plenty of crushed ice. Top with 600ml chilled lemonade just before serving and pour into tall glasses with a lime wedge.

s.how: Cook 300g sushi rice and season with vinegar and sugar. Spread over 4 nori sheets, fill with 200g salmon and avocado and roll tight with a mat. Slice with a wet knife. Serve with soy and pickled ginger. Smile and wave, boys.

Melt 150g dark chocolate with 120g butter, whisk in 200g sugar and 2 eggs and fold in 80g flour. Beat 200g cream cheese with 50g sugar and 1 egg. Spread the brownie in a tin and swirl the cheesecake through in stripes. Bake at 170C for 30 minutes.
